rules.alternatives: Renewal application must be accompanied by evidence of current NCCPA certification (or other board-approved certifying entity); no separate hour count.
rules.notes: Renewal fee $50 per year. PA must report within 10 days if NCCPA certification is lost; the license then expires automatically. Board site (ndbom.org) could not be reached.
rules.rule_quote: 50-03-01-14. License renewal requirements. The physician assistant's license renewal application must be accompanied with evidence of current certification by the national commission on certification of physician assistants or other certifying entity approved by the board.
